20090.long_desc:
The Fire Dragon Arcade Game is an English version, video redemption fish hunting game in which players compete against each other and the clock to catch the most profitable fish and characters!

The English version Fire Dragon Arcade Game is a video redemption game in which anywhere between 6-10 players face off to catch fish and earn credits. The bigger the fish, the more credits you can get!

The Fire Dragon arcade game is quite simple and straight forward. The point and shoot element of the gameplay makes it easy for new players to enter the game and have fun, while the mini games and strategic features create a more challenging experience for experienced players.

Changes to the game include redesigned stages that are more sinister than previous fish games and the fish now come with armoured skins with fluoro accents to help them standout against the new backdrops, making this an exciting new game for experienced players looking for something fresh.

Characters in the Fire Dragon arcade game include:

Lionfish, Spearfish, Clown Fish, Lantern Fish, Turtles, Devilfish, Fugu, Sharks, Butterfly Fish, Lobsters, Octopus, Whales, Golden Sharks, Killer Whales, Bumblebee, Purple Dragon, Fire Dragon and more!

Fire Dragon arcade game features include:

-Bumblebee Golden Time â€“ catch five of the small Bumblebee characters to get an awesome weapon upgrade feature called Golden Time! Players haven to be quick though, the weapon only lasts for a limited time.

-Bumblebee â€“ want to earn 300,000 points in one go? Catch the giant Bumblebee character!

-Lucky Dice â€“ When players catch fish with this effect it will grab all the other fish of the same kind on the playfield at the time and award the collective points to the player!

-Free Bullet/Winnings Energy Cells â€“ floating energy cells that grant players free bullets or large bonuses when caught.
